title: carhunt config
description: Strict: every section lists the keys some code, brief template or skill reads; an unknown key is an error (typo guard). A module that reads a new key adds it here (tests/core/test_config_coverage.py checks module defaults against this file). Free-form maps (site ids, option keys, tiers) use additionalProperties with a value schema. cardb (Go) parses owner/search/cardb itself and rejects or warns on its own; keep both in step.

hardFilter.description: exactly one of field / fact(s) / flag (cardb's grammar; cardb re-validates)

exclude.description: deprecated: only discover's current flag rules need it (they ignore a flag without it); cardb warns on it. Drop once discover excludes on flag alone

predicate.description: contact.nudge predicate over a cardb car: {field, <op>} or {all|any: [...]}

siteOverride.description: per-site tweaks on top of carhunt/sites/<pkg>/site.yaml (dicts merge one level, other values replace)

pace.description: names as in site.schema.json; dicts merge one level over site.yaml

caps.description: per-kind limits read by access.pace (<kind>_per_day/_per_hour/_min_gap_s); _per_session by the site's flow

verification.description: only sms-once allows a rented number

mail_from.description: Gmail query for the site's code/link mails (default from:<site>)

geo.description: search-area params merged into the query (wallapop: latitude/longitude)

tz.description: IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin; checked against zoneinfo at load

min_eur.description: one price floor: discover drops below it, cardb refuses below it (price_lease); default 1500

match.description: discover: regex override for the model match

launchd_prefix.description: must start with carhunt. (checked at use)

email.description: read by agents (skills/carhunt-browsers) for site signups

windows.description: name -> window; must not cross midnight; morning = sites without pace.read_after

price_sanity.description: discover-only parse-error ceiling; the floor is search.price.min_eur (shared with cardb)

channels.description: channel name (whatsapp, email, sites, or a site id) -> settings; a plain list is accepted but enforces nothing

persona.description: free-form lines for briefs, skills and site forms (persona_fields may name any key)

schedule.description: job -> HH:MM or [HH:MM, ...] (null = off); custom jobs need schedule_commands

url.description: web UI base; `carhunt doctor` checks <url>/health (default http://127.0.0.1:4321)
